question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month,
        SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_payments
),
changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        monthly_total - prev_month_total AS monthly_change
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        AVG(ch.monthly_change) AS avg_monthly_change
    FROM changes ch
    JOIN customer c ON ch.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
)
SELECT first_name, last_name, avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
